edits.name: Digital Culture Network
edits.value: Free digital support for creative and cultural organisations in England: one-to-one sessions with specialist Tech Champions, events, a podcast and a Knowledge Hub of guides.

edits.name: Digital Culture Network
edits.value: If you work in an arts organisation, museum or library in England, this is free expert time most teams don't know they can book, on social media, email, websites, accessibility and data. One-to-one support is only for organisations that get, or could get, Arts Council funding. Everyone else can still use the Knowledge Hub.
